name: Trouble Outsiders
original_name: とらぶるあうとさいだーず
source:
A westerner killer is hired in Echigoya of Edo period as a bodyguard. But his self-acclaimed disciple heroine wants to compete with him at every step. Perhaps together they will save the world.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
江户时代的越后屋雇用一名西洋杀手担任保镖。然而，自称是他弟子的女主人公却处处都要与他一较高下。或许，两人最终会携手拯救世界。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-september-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
